global.grade: warm highlights, deep indigo shadows, soft painterly grain
global.lensing: 35mm feel, gentle depth of field on faces, wide for lanes
global.movement_grammar: slow push-ins on emotion; static frames for wonder; never handheld

scenes.shot_framing: medium two-shot at child eye level, stall glow frame-right
scenes.camera_movement: slow push-in 30cm toward Mira as Kenji slips away
scenes.lighting: warm lantern key from the stall, cool night rim from frame-left
scenes.blocking: Mira center-left facing the stall; Kenji at her right hand, exits frame-right into crowd; 180 line along the stall front
scenes.sound_direction: festival drums and crowd murmur; drums swell as Kenji runs
scenes.negative_notes: no modern signage, no cars, crowd never menacing

scenes.shot_framing: wide single, Mira small in the empty lane, lantern glow center
scenes.camera_movement: static frame; the transformation provides the motion
scenes.lighting: single warm source from the lantern, indigo ambience, paper-glow bloom on unfold
scenes.blocking: Mira center facing camera-left toward the floating lantern; Hoshi materializes at her eye level
scenes.sound_direction: crowd fades to silence; paper rustle; single koto note on the bow
scenes.negative_notes: transformation must feel gentle, not startling
